cards.title: Hands-On Dads and a More Peaceful World
cards.body: Evolutionary biologist Sarah Blaffer Hrdy explores how greater paternal involvement could reshape society. Her research challenges traditional assumptions about fatherhood and male parenting roles.

cards.title: Adult Son Returns Home After Graduation
cards.body: Emma Beddington navigates the challenges of having her graduate son back living at home in a tough economy. She humorously reflects on how her parenting instincts kick back in.

cards.title: 4 Ways Parents Support Teen Online Safety
cards.body: Research reveals what teens hide from parents online and how to build trust around digital life. Parents can encourage open communication by understanding adolescent privacy concerns.

cards.title: How to Motivate Children for School Success
cards.body: American students show declining interest in learning, with many high schoolers avoiding reading. Parents can play a key role in rekindling academic motivation and literacy habits.

cards.title: Be the Riverbank for Children's Emotions
cards.body: A riverbank metaphor helps parents contain and support big feelings without suppressing them. This framework allows children to process emotions safely and healthily.

cards.title: Neurodivergence Labels: Understanding Your Child
cards.body: Labels matter in the neurodivergent community but shouldn't define a child's entire identity. Parents benefit from understanding diagnosis while maintaining a holistic view of their child.

cards.title: Childhood Trauma and Grief: Lessons Learned
cards.body: Childhood trauma shapes how grief develops and manifests in adulthood. Understanding this connection helps parents support children processing loss.

cards.title: Social Media Ban Study: Youth Mental Health
cards.body: Britain's largest study examines how social media restrictions affect teenage mental wellbeing. Ten research teams will track adolescent coping mechanisms without digital platforms.
